truth_usage_policy.severity: Scenario metadata; not used for reliability inference
truth_usage_policy.lidar_error: Evaluation label derived from ground truth
truth_usage_policy.ultrasonic_error: Evaluation label derived from ground truth
truth_usage_policy.radar_error: Evaluation label derived from ground truth

scientific_provenance.water_context_depth_proxy: A rule-based observable water-context proxy bounded to 0-20 cm. It represents a context severity score and is NOT a ground-truth water depth estimator
scientific_provenance.measurement_consistency: Inter-sensor measurement consistency based on relative dispersion. High consistency does not automatically guarantee high accuracy if sensors fail in a correlated manner
scientific_provenance.scene_complexity: A bounded phenomenological construct whose coefficients represent predefined expert priors rather than fitted parameters
scientific_provenance.missing_data_handling: Missing observable inputs trigger explicit availability flags and are replaced by predefined neutral engineering priors for continued computation. These imputed values are not treated as direct observations and should be interpreted as uncertainty-bearing defaults.
scientific_provenance.maximum_spread_prior: Measurement spread is normalized using a fixed physical prior (NOMINAL_MAX_SPREAD_CM = 15.0) rather than a transductive dataset-wide percentile
scientific_provenance.adaptive_fusion_estimate: An auxiliary linear-weighted depth estimate is calculated to provide baseline validation for the fusion weights relative to an equal-weighted fusion and the oracle best sensor
scientific_provenance.sensor_availability_flow: Unavailable sensors are strictly propagated: sensor missing -> Reliability = 0 -> Weight = 0 -> measurement contributes nothing to the fusion estimate
